personalEvolution.title: Personal Evolution & Code Philosophy
personalEvolution.desc: Began with low-level C++ memory management and raw algorithm implementation during BCA. Expanded into cloud database optimization and distributed systems during MCA. Today, I combine hardware-accelerated local AI (Project ROSA) with agency-tier interactive web interfaces for high-value clients.

storyTimeline.quote: Building systems that are as elegant to use as they are powerful under the hood.
storyTimeline.desc: Developing custom PHP-based CMS architectures and pioneering Project ROSA — a private offline AI assistant running on local RTX 3070 Ti hardware.

storyTimeline.quote: Deepening theoretical foundations in cloud architecture and distributed AI.

storyTimeline.title: Website & Office Coordinator — Labour Party of India
storyTimeline.quote: Digitizing large-scale operations for seamless data intelligence.
storyTimeline.desc: Digitized operational records, optimized website data flow and managed SQL databases for member tracking and voter data processing.

storyTimeline.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications — BCA
storyTimeline.quote: Where the journey began — raw algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented mastery.
storyTimeline.desc: Core foundation in Algorithms, Data Structures and OOP with C++ and Java. Developed custom physics game engines and memory-safe console software.

projects.title: Blue Heaven Camp
projects.desc: High-performance custom CMS for a luxury riverside camping resort with real-time booking pipeline.
projects.challenge: Client needed a premium, fast-loading storefront for luxury tents with a direct WhatsApp booking pipeline.
projects.solution: Built highly optimized static site with dynamic component loader via Fetch API and custom PHP CMS.
projects.result: Sub-2s load times, direct WhatsApp booking conversions, SEO-optimized for holiday search traffic.

projects.title: Bhandari Adventure
projects.desc: Full-stack tourism CMS handling peak-season real-time bookings, a dynamic gallery, and SEO landings.
projects.challenge: Client needed a scalable backend capable of handling seasonal traffic spikes and media-heavy gallery.
projects.solution: Custom PHP CMS with image compression pipeline, booking system, and WhatsApp routing.
projects.result: Handles 10x peak traffic spikes, bookings increased by 40%, gallery serves 200+ compressed images.

projects.title: Academia
projects.desc: Repository of academic coursework, algorithm implementations, and core CS concepts.
projects.challenge: Organizing years of academic projects into a single accessible and well-documented resource.
projects.solution: Centralized GitHub repository serving as a knowledge base for core data structures and algorithms.
projects.result: Public reference used by peers; clean documentation and working examples for all major algorithms.

projects.title: Project ROSA
projects.desc: Context-Aware offline AI Avatar running on local RTX 3070 Ti for absolute privacy and zero latency.
projects.challenge: Cloud AI compromises privacy and requires constant internet. Consumer hardware potential was untapped.
projects.solution: Runs on local RTX 3070 Ti using quantized LLMs. Zero network packets. Full voice-to-text via Whisper.
projects.result: Sub-50ms response latency, 100% offline, voice-controlled with full system API access.

projects.title: Android Streamer
projects.desc: Low-latency screen mirroring tool bypassing standard Android protocols by tapping raw ADB.
projects.challenge: Standard mirroring solutions suffer 200ms+ latency — unusable for gaming and real-time apps.
projects.solution: Bypassed casting protocols. Tapped directly into Android Debug Bridge raw frame buffer via FFmpeg.
projects.result: Sub-50ms latency achieved, fully open source toolkit for power users and developers.

projects.title: @tigml Analytics
projects.desc: Data-driven content growth framework for a 50k+ MOBA channel — predicting meta-shifts.
projects.challenge: The MOBA content market is saturated. Needed a way to predict virality before trends peak.
projects.solution: Built data analysis framework using Excel to identify win-rates and drive high-CTR content timing.
projects.result: 50k+ subscribers, CTR consistently above platform average, viral timing predictions validated.

projects.title: MH_2D Engine
projects.desc: Custom 2D Action RPG game engine built from scratch in Java — handling collision detection.
projects.challenge: Wanted to deeply understand game physics without relying on Unity or Godot abstractions.
projects.solution: Wrote custom Java engine handling collision, sprite rendering, and complex multi-phase boss AI state machine.
projects.result: Fully functional RPG engine with 60fps render loop, boss AI, and sprite management.

projects.title: Secure Vault
projects.desc: Terminal-based transaction management system with raw file encryption for secure banking data.
projects.challenge: Banking backends require absolute memory safety and data integrity without bloated frameworks.
projects.solution: C++ application using raw pointers for speed and AES-style encryption for secure transaction logs.
projects.result: Zero memory leaks (Valgrind-verified), AES encryption on all transaction files, passes audit trail.

projects.title: ShopEasy E-Commerce
projects.desc: Full-featured e-commerce store for a local fashion brand with UPI/card payment integration.
projects.challenge: Client needed a self-managed shop with inventory, orders, and customer data — no monthly Shopify fees.
projects.solution: Custom PHP storefront with product DB, cart logic, Razorpay integration, and admin dashboard.
projects.result: One-time cost vs recurring SaaS fees, full data ownership, UPI payments live with zero commission.

projects.title: PropertyVista
projects.desc: Real estate listing platform with interactive map-based property explorer and lead pipeline.
projects.challenge: Static real estate sites lose leads. Needed a map-first UX with live filtering by price, BHK, and area.
projects.solution: PHP CMS with Leaflet.js map integration. Properties load dynamically by filter via AJAX endpoints.
projects.result: 3x lead capture improvement, agents manage listings independently, map explorer drives engagement.

projects.title: EventPulse
projects.desc: End-to-end event ticketing system with QR-based gate check-in, seat mapping, and admin portal.
projects.challenge: Local event organizers relied on manual entry and cash — losses from fake tickets were critical.
projects.solution: PHP platform with JWT-secured QR tickets, organizer dashboard, and a mobile gate-check scanner page.
projects.result: Zero fake ticket incidents in pilot, gate check-in time reduced from 3min to 8sec per attendee.

projects.title: Roshan Panday Portfolio & Systems
projects.desc: Founded & Operated by Roshan Panday. High-Performance Digital Architecture Studio featuring WebGL liquid shaders, GSAP animations, and interactive pricing tools.
projects.challenge: Demonstrating high-tier agency-level web engineering as a solo developer to win premium enterprise clients.
projects.solution: Built a cinematic React agency platform with custom R3F Three.js particle wireframes, Lenis smooth scroll, and CMS automation.
projects.result: Positions Roshan as a top-1% solo technical architect; drives high-ticket freelance client acquisition.

projects.title: Juris Global Legal Solutions
projects.desc: Authoritative corporate law firm web platform with secure client intake portal, lawyer consultation scheduling, and legal document repository.
projects.challenge: Legal corporate clients demand high trust signals, absolute confidentiality, fast search of practice areas, and accessible retainer consultation booking.
projects.solution: Engineered modern corporate legal portal with dark-blue trust typography, encrypted client document upload, responsive practice area matrix, and calendar integration.
projects.result: 45% increase in online consultation bookings, reduced client intake onboarding time from 2 days to 15 minutes.

projects.title: Bill & Invoice Generator
projects.desc: Embedded professional document automation utility for generating client receipts, project handover slips, and technical SOPs with instant PDF export.
projects.challenge: Freelancers waste hours crafting manual invoices and handover documents for clients, causing delayed payments and administrative overhead.
projects.solution: Built a zero-backend client-side invoice generator into the portfolio OS with dynamic line items, INR/USD currency conversion, official digital stamps, and print styles.
projects.result: Generates print-ready vector PDF documents in seconds; embedded directly in portfolio admin toolkit.
